correctness.rationale: Every 3^n word at n=3,4,5,6 and all n(n-1)/2 exchange pairs were tested using exact integer utilities. Tarjan SCC enumeration gives 0,0,0,6 nontrivial components; at n=6 all six have six states and six internal edges, one symmetry orbit of 36 states, with explicit six-step strictly improving cycle and stable welfare-maximum witness. This proves the finite boundary, not an assertion for n>6.

value.rationale: The three-type cyclic approvals are the distinctive asymmetric case in the original general stability proof. The exact first failure of ordinary improving-swap convergence exposes a clear structural difference between static guaranteed equilibrium and dynamic reachability; its six SCCs and single symmetry orbit constitute a complete naturally minimal boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
